standards_evidence: The approved production source preserves Diez42 content, policy links, existing contact destinations, and the canonical v249.0 source marker.
The production homepage has six stable CTA IDs, a fixed bottom-right version pill, and an aggregate measurement notice; the noindex review route remains excluded.
WST instrumentation is sessionless, origin-pinned, non-blocking, query-normalizing, and suppressed by Global Privacy Control or Do Not Track.
The 2026-09-09 live matrix covered 320/375/390/768/1280 and 844x390 landscape with no horizontal overflow; the mobile sticky CTA and version pill retained a measured 10px clearance when visible.
Chrome DevTools traces recorded LCP 100ms at 1280x900 on Fast 4G/1x CPU and LCP 163ms at 390x844 on Fast 3G/4x CPU, with CLS 0.00 in both; field data is unavailable.

Keyboard focus reached the skip link, navigation, settings, CTAs, and policy links; Lighthouse mobile and desktop audits scored 100 for accessibility, best practices, SEO, and agentic browsing with no failed audits.
Native browser 200% zoom and live reduced-motion emulation remain unverified; the source includes a reduced-motion rule, and field vitals remain unavailable.
